edition.en: Poems by Emily Dickinson (1890), edited by Mabel Loomis Todd and T. W. Higginson, on Project Gutenberg (eBook 12242)
edition.zh: 据古登堡计划电子书 12242 所录《艾米莉·狄金森诗集》（1890），托德与希金森编

basis.en: First published in 1890, after the author’s death in 1886; the editors died in 1911 and 1932.
basis.zh: 1890 年首次出版，作者已于 1886 年去世；两位编者分别卒于 1911 年和 1932 年。

note.en: Eight short lines on knowing what one has never seen: the heather from a description, the sea from a word. It is a compact case for reading as a way of knowing, and a gentle one about faith.
note.zh: 八行短句，写人能知道自己从没见过的东西：从一段描述知道石南，从一个词知道大海。它以极小的篇幅为“阅读也是一种认知”作了辩护，也温和地谈到了信。

excerpt.orig:
Yet certain am I of the spot
As if the chart were given.
excerpt.en:
Yet certain am I of the spot
As if the chart were given.
excerpt.zh:
却确知那个地方，
仿佛手里有一张海图。
